claims.label: Lance Wallnau's November 6, 2020 Facebook Post Urged "Stop the Steal"
claims.claim: A Facebook post by Lance Wallnau dated November 6, 2020 was read aloud in the episode and stated: "We're going to expose the fraud and stop the steal. The Lord our God is with us, and we were built for this battle. Be strong and courageous."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve and verify the original Facebook post via archive (e.g., Wayback Machine) or screenshot.

claims.label: Clip: Lance Wallnau Describes the Seven Mountain Mandate
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on the episode, Lance Wallnau defined the seven mountain mandate as covering religion, education, family, government, media, art/entertainment, and business/economics, and described pursuing it either "covert" or "overt."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full source video to verify exact wording, context, and date.

claims.label: Clip Presented as Turek Calls Word of Faith Hermeneutic Aberrant and Occult-Like
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on the episode, presented by the host as Frank Turek, after the New Apostolic Reformation is named, a speaker describing the Word of Faith movement says its hermeneutic is "aberrant" and that its adherents do things "more new agey or more even occult-like than they are Christian"; the host introduces the clip by saying Turek acknowledged NAR was a cult, "actually darker than a cult."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full source audio/podcast to verify exact wording and full context.

claims.label: Host Says Baker Identified Capitol Police Officer as Pipe-Bomb Dropper
claims.claim: The host says the person responsible for dropping off the January 6 pipe bombs was revealed to be a 31-year-old woman and United States Capitol Police officer she names as Shauni Kerkhoff, credits reporter Steve Baker with the discovery, plays Glenn Beck interviewing Baker (who says a federal source responded "She's one of us"), and says it was a 5-year investigation involving forensic analysis.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against federal charging documents, the Glenn Beck broadcast archive, and Steve Baker's contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: Liz Lyons (CIA) Stated Shauni Kerkhoff Worked in Capitol Police Campus Security
claims.claim: CIA spokeswoman Liz Lyons, as relayed by the host, stated that Shauni Kerkhoff, "the alleged person who dropped off these pipe bombs," worked in Capitol Police Campus Security; the host adds that she lives in Alexandria, Virginia.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original CIA press statement or statement of record to verify wording and confirm whether "Kerkhoff" and "Kirkup" refer to the same individual.

claims.label: Frank McCormick Claimed AI Analysis Showed Charlie Kirk Text Messages Were "Digitally Fabricated"
claims.claim: Frank McCormick posted on X that AI analysis of bubble design, profile placement, header layout, font, spacing, and color balance of the Charlie Kirk text messages displayed by Candace Owens concluded the messages were "digitally fabricated."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original X post and the underlying AI analysis to assess methodology and reliability.

claims.label: Text Messages Displayed On Air as Allegedly From Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Text messages displayed on air, presented by the host as authentic messages between Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens, included the passage: "Iron sharpens iron. It's not a dominance partnership. Each hand washes the other."
claims.investigative_direction: Forensic examination of the displayed text metadata, corroborating testimony, and chain-of-custody verification.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Tweeted Verse About Losing One's Soul
claims.claim: Per the tweet the host shows, Seth Dillon (Babylon Bee) posted the verse "what do you benefit if you gain the whole world but lose your own soul"; the host says he tweeted it when her podcast hit number one globally.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve and verify the original tweet on Seth Dillon's X account.

claims.label: Joel Berry Tweeted That Candace/Tucker Gave the Right "Demoralization, Division, Confusion, and Conflict"
claims.claim: Joel Berry (Babylon Bee) tweeted that in the last year Candace and Tucker had given "our side nothing but demoralization, division, confusion, and conflict," calling their impact "devastating" and "pathetic."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve and verify the original tweet on Joel Berry's X account.

claims.label: Grok Stated Candace Owens Accused Turning Point USA of Orchestrating Kirk's Assassination
claims.claim: Grok (X AI) issued a public statement read aloud in the episode claiming that "Candace Owens accused Turning Point USA of Charlie Kirk assassination role" and that she alleged TPUSA orchestrated the October 15, 2025 assassination via former volunteer Marcus Hale.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Grok/X post and compare against Candace Owens' contemporaneous statements on the show.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Said Implicating a Real Person in a Murder Plot Requires Hard Evidence
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on the episode, Allie Beth Stuckey told people who say they are seeking truth and asking questions that they were "outsourcing your critical thinking," and warned that implicating a real person in a murder plot required being "100% sure" and backed by "hard evidence."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full source video to verify exact wording and full context.

claims.label: Mark Levin Declined Tucker Carlson's Debate Request
claims.claim: In an audio clip played on the episode, Mark Levin responded to Tucker Carlson's debate offer with the text-message reply "My family and I want nothing to do with you," and called Carlson a "Nazi promoter" and "modern-day David Duke," stating he would "rather debate a skunk than" Carlson.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full Mark Levin broadcast to verify exact wording and any additional context.

claims.label: Keri Smith (Deprogrammed) Said Candace Owens Exhibits "Cult Tactics" and "Cluster B Personality Disorder Behavior"
claims.claim: Keri Smith, host of the Deprogrammed podcast, in audio played on the episode, said Candace Owens "is exhibiting several cult tactics" and "a lot of cluster B personality disorder behavior."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full Deprogrammed episode to verify exact wording and complete reasoning.

claims.label: BBC Reported a Las Vegas Shooting Survivor Was Among the Dead at the Borderline Bar & Grill
claims.claim: A BBC headline referenced in the episode reported that a Las Vegas shooting survivor was among the dead at the Borderline Bar and Grill shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original BBC article to verify the headline, the identity of the survivor, and the broader reporting.

claims.label: Feds Allegedly Seized Footage at Timpanogos Hospital on the Day of the Kirk Shooting
claims.claim: According to tips the host says she received, federal agents seized footage at Timpanogos Hospital on the day of the Charlie Kirk shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via FOIA requests, hospital records, contemporaneous reporting, or independent witness testimony.

claims.label: Host Says Only Zionists Seem to Believe the Fed Story
claims.claim: The host says it is odd that the only people who seem to believe the Fed story are Zionists, and that their panic suggests she is getting closer to something big.
claims.investigative_direction: This is a sweeping group characterisation; it could only be tested by surveying who publicly endorsed the official account.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's kind of weird how the only people that seem to believe the Fed story are Zionists

claims.label: Host Says Timpanogos Was Trauma Three While UV Hospital Was Trauma One
claims.claim: The host says Timpanogos Hospital, where Charlie Kirk was taken, was further away and less equipped than UV Hospital, which she describes as a trauma one center against Timpanogos as trauma three.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Utah trauma center designations for both hospitals and the distance from the UVU campus.
claims.transcript_snippet: UV was a trauma one, and Timpanogos was trauma three

claims.label: Host Says Others Told Her Charlie Was Definitely at UV Hospital
claims.claim: The host says that after people found it strange that Charlie Kirk was taken to Timpanogos, she and others started hearing from other people that he was definitely at UV Hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the people who told the host this and compare against UV Hospital and EMS records.
claims.transcript_snippet: we started hearing from other people that he was definitely at UV Hospital

claims.label: Host Says Nobody Has Shown Charlie Arriving at Timpanogos Despite News Cameras
claims.claim: The host says no one has produced footage of the vehicles pulling up at Timpanogos, even though news cameras, oddly from a New York news channel, were waiting outside.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the New York news crew present at Timpanogos and request its raw footage and logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: not a single person who captured them pulling up, nothing, despite the fact that there were news cameras outside waiting, oddly from like new a New York news channel

claims.label: Host Says Nothing Fixes the Time Charlie Arrived at the Hospital
claims.claim: The host says nothing publicly available lets her build onto her timeline the time at which Charlie arrived at the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ambulance or vehicle arrival log, hospital intake record and 911 timestamps for the Timpanogos arrival.
claims.transcript_snippet: we have not seen anything regarding that that we can build incompetently on our timeline that would let us know what time in particular Charlie arrived at the hospital

claims.label: Host Says Feds Also Moved on Footage Outside the Hospital
claims.claim: The host says she feels something is amiss if the Feds moved to grab the footage inside the hospital and outside the hospital immediately.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the hospital and any federal agency for evidence receipts and chain-of-custody records for exterior and interior video.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Feds moved to grab the footage inside of the hospital immediately and outside of the hospital immediately

claims.label: Host Asks for Footage of the Black SUV at the Hospital via Tip Line
claims.claim: The host asks anyone who has footage of a black SUV pulling up at the hospital to send it to moretips@candaceowens.com.
claims.investigative_direction: Check what, if anything, was later received and published in response to this request.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you maybe were somebody who has footage and saw that black SUV pull up at the hospital, please get that to us at moretips@candaceowens. com

claims.label: Host Says Fed Strategy Is to Put Out a Sloppy Narrative
claims.claim: The host says she is starting to wonder whether every major publicly traumatizing event was organized by the Feds, and that their usual strategy is to get out a sloppy narrative rather than blame themselves.
claims.investigative_direction: Speculative generalization; not testable as stated beyond individual events.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm starting to wonder if every major publicly traumatizing event may have actually just been organized by the Feds

claims.label: Baker Says His Federal Source Replied Holy F and She Is One of Us
claims.claim: In the Glenn Beck interview played on air, Steve Baker says he took what he found to a source in a top federal investigative agency, who after about two hours replied "Holy F" and then "She's one of us." He says he pulled the thread two weeks earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Baker or Blaze Media to identify the agency level and the date he first pulled the thread; seek documentary support.
claims.transcript_snippet: After they looked at it for about 2 hours, the response that I got back was "Holy F." And then the follow-up response was "She's one of us."

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Investigation May Sweep Up Same People as January 6
claims.claim: The host says many people will get swept up in the Charlie Kirk investigation, perhaps the same people who will be swept up over January 6.
claims.investigative_direction: Predictive; track later charging, resignations or testimony tied to both matters.
claims.transcript_snippet: A lot of people are going to get swept up in this investigation, perhaps the same people that are going to get swept up in the January 6th.

claims.label: Host Says Blaze Editor Was Stopped by Police at Kerkhoff Home
claims.claim: The host says Shauni Kerkhoff lives in Alexandria, Virginia and is apparently under the watch of law enforcement, because the Blaze News editor-in-chief drove to her house and was instantly stopped by local police before being let go.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Blaze News whether its editor visited the address and whether a police contact was recorded; request the local police log.
claims.transcript_snippet: The Blaze News editor-in-chief decided to pull up to her house to just kind of see if any action was happening at her home. And then he instantly got stopped by local police before they allowed him to leave.

claims.label: Host Says Four of Six January 6 Permits Went to Charismatic Christian Groups
claims.claim: The host says four of the six protest permits issued for January 6 were issued to independent charismatic Christian groups.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the National Park Service permit list for January 6, 2021 and the applicants' affiliations.
claims.transcript_snippet: four out of the six uh protest permits that were issued on January 6th were issued to independent charismatic Christian groups

claims.label: Host Says Fifteen Pastors Surrounded Trump Before January 6 Saying the War Was Spiritual
claims.claim: The host says fifteen pastors and leaders surrounded Donald Trump at the White House before the January 6 rally and told him the war was now spiritual.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the White House visitor logs or published photos for the meeting and the attendee list.
claims.transcript_snippet: 15 of these pastors and leaders surrounded Trump at the White House leading up to the January 6th um Stop the Steal rally telling him that the war was now spiritual

claims.label: Host Cites Article Saying NAR Drove January 6 and Naming Wallnau and Feucht
claims.claim: The host reads the title of an article saying the New Apostolic Reformation drove the January 6 riots and asking why the House Select Committee overlooked it, and says Lance Wallnau and Sean Feucht are named in it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the publication and author of the article, confirm its title and whether Wallnau and Feucht are named.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's an article about that. The new apostolic reformation drove the January 6th riots. So, why was it overlooked by the House Select Committee?

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Became Mesmerized by the Seven Mountain Mandate and Befriended Wallnau
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk became very interested in, even mesmerized by, the Seven Mountain Mandate and became friends with Lance Wallnau.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for public photos, posts or event appearances of Kirk with Wallnau and any Kirk remarks about the Seven Mountain Mandate.
claims.transcript_snippet: I would say like he became mesmerized by the seven mountain mandate. He became friends with Lance Wallnau.

claims.label: Wallnau Clip Traces Mandate to a 2000 Talk with Loren Cunningham and Bill Bright
claims.claim: In the clip played on air, Lance Wallnau says the Seven Mountain Mandate began with a conversation in 2000 with Loren Cunningham, founder of Youth With A Mission, who described a conversation with Bill Bright in which each was told by the Lord that he had a message for the other.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Wallnau video and compare with other tellings of the Cunningham and Bright story.
claims.transcript_snippet: it started with a conversation I had in the year 2000. I had been talking to Loren Cunningham, who's the founder of Youth With A Mission.

claims.label: Host Says Turning Point Faith Keeps Coming Up Wherever She Investigates
claims.claim: The host says that everywhere she is investigating, Turning Point Faith keeps coming up.
claims.investigative_direction: List the specific leads and sources the host has tied to Turning Point Faith across the series.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point Faith, everywhere that I'm investigating, Turning Point Faith keeps coming up.

claims.label: Host Says Many Mainstream Pastors Come from High-Ranking Military Families
claims.claim: The host says she notices that many mainstream pastors and preachers come from high-ranking military families, citing Frank Turek's Air Force background and Rob McCoy's naval background, which she links to psychological operations.
claims.investigative_direction: Check biographies of the named pastors against military service records and family history.
claims.transcript_snippet: a lot of these mainstream pastors and preachers actually come from high-ranking military families

claims.label: Host Says Wallnau Graduated from a Military Academy
claims.claim: The host says Lance Wallnau graduated from a military academy.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Wallnau's published biography for the academy and graduation year.
claims.transcript_snippet: Lance Wallnau, he's no different. He graduated from a military academy.

claims.label: Host Says Carl Wallnau Was an Air Force Major Who Served Under Patton
claims.claim: The host says Lance Wallnau's father Carl Wallnau was a major in the US Air Force who served under General Patton and later worked as a field engineer for Standard Oil installing liquid propane systems in places such as Haiti, Cuba and the Dominican Republic.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Carl Wallnau's service record or obituary and any Standard Oil employment record.
claims.transcript_snippet: His father, Carl Wallnau, was a major in the United States Air Force, okay? Wallnau served under General Patton. After the war, he then continued his adventures as a field engineer for Standard Oil

claims.label: Host Says Turek Did Not Warn Charlie About NAR Infiltration
claims.claim: The host says that after calling NAR a cult, Frank Turek did not warn Charlie Kirk as NAR people began to infiltrate Turning Point.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Turek or Kirk's associates whether any warning was given; look for recorded conversations.
claims.transcript_snippet: it didn't make him go warn Charlie about this in any way as these people began to infiltrate his organization

claims.label: Host Relays Administration-Adjacent Person Asking When Turning Point Became Faith-Focused
claims.claim: The host says a person extremely close to the current administration told her, after being at Charlie's memorial, that Turning Point used to be about free markets and capitalism and suddenly became faith, faith, faith, with pastors everywhere.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Turning Point event agendas over time and identify when faith programming expanded.
claims.transcript_snippet: She said, "When did Turning Point become so faith-focused?"

claims.label: Host Says Faith-Department Sources Say Wallnau Funded Turning Point Faith
claims.claim: The host says Lance Wallnau was working with Rob McCoy, and that sources within Turning Point's faith department told her Wallnau was running the show behind the scenes through funding and put a ton of money into Turning Point USA Faith operations.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain donor or ministry records, Turning Point Faith budgets, or testimony from the faith-department sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sources within Turning Point's faith department tell me that Lance was running the show behind the scenes through funding.

claims.label: Host Says Wallnau Was Friends with McCoy, Toured with Turning Point Faith and Knew Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Wallnau is friends with Rob McCoy, eventually did tour stops with Turning Point Faith, and knew Charlie, who he said was his friend.
claims.investigative_direction: Check tour announcements for Turning Point Faith stops featuring Wallnau and public statements by Wallnau about Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's friends with Rob Rob McCoy, um and he eventually did tour stops with Turning Point Faith. And he knew Charlie. He said Charlie was his friend.

claims.label: Host Says Mel on X Has Done Good Work on the Faith-Military Constellation
claims.claim: The host says the Village Crazy Lady, Mel on X, has been doing great work on the faith-military constellation, which the host proposes calling the militant faith pipeline.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Mel's X threads and which claims in them the host relies on.
claims.transcript_snippet: I told you guys about Mel on X, she's been doing great work on this, but you need to start investigating this faith mil- military constellation.

claims.label: Host Says 2017 Las Vegas Shooting Killed 58 and the Official Story Was Lone Gunman Paddock
claims.claim: The host says the October 1, 2017 Las Vegas shooting killed 58 people and injured more than 600, and that the official account was a lone shooter, Stephen Paddock.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the official casualty figures from the Las Vegas investigation record.
claims.transcript_snippet: 58 people were murdered. More than 600 others were injured. And they told us that it was just a lone shooter, Stephen Paddock

claims.label: Host Says Conspiracy Theorists Had Ton of Evidence Las Vegas Was a Military Operation
claims.claim: The host says conspiracy theorists claimed the Las Vegas shooting was a military operation and that there was a ton of evidence to support it.
claims.investigative_direction: The host cites no specific evidence here; ask which evidence she means.
